image_description: A close-up shot of several green, elongated vegetables inside a clear glass bowl. The vegetables have a distinct longitudinal ribbed or fluted texture and appear to be sliced lengthwise or are naturally segmented. They possess a gradient of color from dark green skin to pale green/white interior flesh. There is a faint watermark text '123' visible in the center.
